description.zh: ECI实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入。
description.en: The IDs of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

description.zh:
限定此次返回资源（ECI实例）的数量。默认为200个。

> 返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
description.en:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. The default value is 200.

> The number of instances returned is less than or equal to the specified value.

description.zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。    
首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取。
description.en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. You can get the token from the `NextToken` parameter in the response to the previous request.

description.zh: 返回最近几秒内有状态更新的ECI实例状态，用于轮询查询状态。
description.en: The time in seconds. The operation returns the status of ECI instances that were updated within this time period. This parameter is used for polling.
The tags attached to the ECI instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-container-group-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-k --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --resource-group-id rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --container-group-ids eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000 --since-second 60 --tag Value=testValue Key=testKey --next-token d78f2dd8-5979-42fe-xaee-b16db43be5bc --limit 200 --region cn-hangzhou
